sources.snippet: Hermes Spam Filter 🛡️ Hermes Spam Filter is a lightweight, custom-built PyTorch Transformer classifier engineered from scratch for high-throughput, low-latency binary text classification (SPAM vs. HAM). It is designed specifically for SMS spam filtering, chat moderation, and transactional email verification.

sources.title: GitHub - Tritonix711/Spam-Filter-AI: Spam Filter AI is a project in ...
sources.snippet: Spam Filter AI is a project in Python that uses machine learning to detect spam emails. It uses Natural Language Processing (NLP) and Naive Bayes classification. The program reads email content, converts it into useful data with TF-IDF vectorization, and then decides if the email is spam or not, keeping your inbox clean and organized.
